entities.name: RlmN-like protein
observations: 349-aa query is homologous to reviewed bacterial RlmN proteins (45–47% identity; about 94–96% query coverage; E-values 5.6e-86 to 1.5e-89).
Predicted function by homology: radical-SAM RNA methyltransferase, likely modifying 23S rRNA A2503 and tRNA A37.
Predicted cytoplasmic localization based on annotated bacterial RlmN homologs; direct localization for the query was not established.
Pfam identifies a Radical_SAM domain at residues 101–266.

entities.name: rRNA base methylation
observations: RlmN homologs are annotated in rRNA base methylation, specifically 23S rRNA adenine 2503 C2 methylation.

entities.name: tRNA methylation
observations: RlmN homologs are annotated in tRNA methylation, specifically tRNA adenine 37 C2 methylation.
